column3: MT 63:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “I am seeking You” is rendered “I shall seek You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will extol You” is rendered “will praise You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in my life” is rendered “as long as I live.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fat” is rendered “marrow.”
“They will pour him out” is rendered “They will be delivered over,” and “the hands of the sword” as “the power of the sword.”
